name: stub-auth
description: Stub AI provider driver for core-auth: canned responses to validate the auth pipeline; the reference example for building provider plugins.
author: intisy

scripts.build: node node_modules/@intisy-ai/api/scripts/teavm-build.mjs --java-dir . --module :stub-teavm --out src/generated/stub-provider.teavm.js && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); import('./src/generated/stub-provider.teavm.js').then(m=>fs.writeFileSync('src/generated/stub-models.json', m.buildModelsJson(3)))" && npx esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --external:@intisy-ai/core --external:@intisy-ai/core-auth --external:@intisy-ai/core-ir --external:sync-bridge --outfile=dist/index.js && npx esbuild src/handler.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --external:@intisy-ai/core --external:@intisy-ai/core-auth --external:@intisy-ai/core-ir --external:sync-bridge --outfile=dist/handler.js && npx esbuild src/javaProvider.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --external:@intisy-ai/core --external:@intisy-ai/core-auth --external:@intisy-ai/core-ir --outfile=dist/javaProvider.js && npx esbuild src/driver.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --external:@intisy-ai/core --external:@intisy-ai/core-auth --external:@intisy-ai/core-ir --external:sync-bridge --outfile=dist/driver.js && npx esbuild src/plugin.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --external:@intisy-ai/core --external:@intisy-ai/core-auth --external:@intisy-ai/core-ir --external:sync-bridge --outfile=dist/plugin.js
